purpose: Prevent owner teaching from becoming passive archive-only memory when it can be converted into measurable operating intelligence.

classification.meaning: Useful owner principle or reasoning context that may inform future interpretation but is not itself a measurable external fact.
Owner request can be measured from a canonical source now and should become a visible metric/event when engineering scope permits.
Owner request is measurable in principle but the canonical source/adapter or attribution contract does not exist yet; preserve it explicitly until resolved.
Causal or market thesis to test against future evidence; never silently promote to observed fact.

operatingRules: Do not treat 'owner context is not an external source of truth' as permission to ignore owner teaching.
Convert measurable owner ideas into active tracking definitions or explicit coverage gaps rather than leaving them only in prose memory.
Expose the count and identities of genuinely tracked event types in the internal agents console.
Expose coverage gaps separately so planned intelligence is never counted as already implemented.
Publish only source-backed or deterministic-derived events in the operating feed.
Never infer protocol-volume/fee causality solely from APR, TVL or reward movement.
Revisit coverage gaps as collectors and canonical history improve.
Future Curators should be able to use the same event layer to explain meaningful company changes to owners.
ownerRequestedExamples: company TVL moves at least 10% between daily observations
company or protocol reference yield changes materially
generated income and cash-flow counters advance
protocol trading volume, fees or revenue changes when canonical sources are available
explain protocol economics to company cash-flow linkage only when mechanism-specific evidence supports it
show high-quality operating events as a concise news-like feed in /agents/
